title: The runner's secrets and visibility: lane token, signing key or attestations, a capped OpenRouter key; public or private repository
summary: Dinis: RUNNER.md's decisions for you. (2) Public (free minutes and attestations; logs public, so metadata only) or private (logs private, minutes metered).
